## Deploying care-preview with    Cloudflare Pages
Latest commit: 3636352
Status: ✅  Deploy successful!
Preview URL: https://f71acd72.care-preview-a7w.pages.dev
Branch Preview URL: https://copilot-route-level-code-spl.care-preview-a7w.pages.dev
[View logs](https://dash.cloudflare.com/?to=/db6d08276fae8cc36808cc6d13f71ca6/pages/view/care-preview/f71acd72-db1a-40e9-baaa-8d60ef7e5cf3)

Because only HTML is now precached and the old service worker serves that cached shell, reloading is not guaranteed to pick up the new asset graph. After a deploy, opening an old route chunk that was never runtime-cached can therefore trigger this handler, reload the same old HTML, request the same missing chunk, and loop indefinitely. The recovery path needs to invalidate/update the service worker caches before reloading and must guard against repeated reloads.

This strategy caches any successful response, but the production fallback at `nginx/nginx.conf:23-25` returns `index.html` with status 200 for a missing `/assets/*` URL. After a deployment removes an old hashed chunk, the worker can therefore cache HTML under that script/style URL for 30 days, repeatedly causing module MIME/parse failures. Add a `cacheWillUpdate` plugin that rejects responses whose content type does not match the request destination (or make `/assets/` return a real 404).

Wrapping this component changes its identity: `PatientProfile.tsx:151` still compares `Tab.component !== PatientNotesTab`, where `PatientNotesTab` is the original eagerly imported function. The lazy wrapper is never equal to that function, so the actions sidebar now appears on the Notes tab even though it was previously suppressed. Compare the tab route (for example, `Tab?.route !== "notes"`) instead of component identity and remove the eager import.

The newly installed worker cannot intercept the entry JavaScript/CSS requests that initiated its first registration, so with this HTML-only precache those assets are not added to `care-code` on a user's first visit. An offline reload then depends on incidental HTTP-cache retention rather than the PWA cache and can serve `index.html` without the assets needed to boot. Preserve a minimal precached entry graph (while excluding lazy routes), or explicitly warm the current entry assets after activation.

## Copilot review overview ### 🟡 Changes recommended The cache strategy risks offline failures and deployment reload loops, while lazy-wrapping the notes tab changes existing UI behavior. *Get a fresh assessment by requesting another Copilot review.* **Review effort:** Balanced **Findings:** 2 · 2

This marker is never cleared or expired. After one stale-chunk recovery, a long-lived tab at the same URL cannot recover from a later deployment because every subsequent `vite:preloadError` returns here. Use a timestamp/cooldown or clear the marker after a confirmed successful boot so it prevents only an immediate reload loop.
